{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Auth.SessionManager where

import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.IORef
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import System.Random (randomRIO)
import Data.Time.Clock (UTCTime, getCurrentTime, addUTCTime)
import Control.Monad (when, unless)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe, isJust)

type SessionId = Text
type UserId = Text
type ServiceToken = Text

data SessionState = SessionState
  { sessUser      :: Maybe UserId
  , sessCreatedAt :: UTCTime
  , sessLastAuth  :: Maybe UTCTime
  , sessServiceTokens :: Map.Map Text ServiceToken
  , sessElevated  :: Bool
  } deriving (Show)

data SessionStore = SessionStore
  { storeSessions :: IORef (Map.Map SessionId SessionState)
  , storeConfig   :: AuthConfig
  }

data AuthConfig = AuthConfig
  { cfgSessionTimeout  :: Int
  , cfgRequireReauth   :: Bool
  , cfgTrustedServices :: [Text]
  , cfgRegenerateOnElevation :: Bool
  } deriving (Show)

defaultConfig :: AuthConfig
defaultConfig = AuthConfig
  { cfgSessionTimeout = 3600
  , cfgRequireReauth = True
  , cfgTrustedServices = ["payment-svc", "profile-svc", "audit-svc"]
  , cfgRegenerateOnElevation = True
  }

generateSessionId :: IO SessionId
generateSessionId = do
  bytes <- mapM (\_ -> randomRIO (0, 255 :: Int)) [1..32]
  return $ T.pack $ concatMap (\b -> let h = showHex b in if length h == 1 then '0':h else h) bytes
  where
    showHex n = let digits = "0123456789abcdef"
                    hi = digits !! (n `div` 16)
                    lo = digits !! (n `mod` 16)
                in [hi, lo]

newSessionStore :: AuthConfig -> IO SessionStore
newSessionStore cfg = do
  ref <- newIORef Map.empty
  return $ SessionStore ref cfg

createSession :: SessionStore -> IO SessionId
createSession store = do
  sid <- generateSessionId
  now <- getCurrentTime
  let sess = SessionState
        { sessUser = Nothing
        , sessCreatedAt = now
        , sessLastAuth = Nothing
        , sessServiceTokens = Map.empty
        , sessElevated = False
        }
  modifyIORef' (storeSessions store) (Map.insert sid sess)
  return sid

-- Cross-service authentication callback
-- Called when an external trusted service validates a user
serviceAuthCallback :: SessionStore -> SessionId -> Text -> UserId -> ServiceToken -> IO (Either Text SessionId)
serviceAuthCallback store sid serviceName uid token = do
  sessions <- readIORef (storeSessions store)
  case Map.lookup sid sessions of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Invalid session"
    Just sess -> do
      let trusted = serviceName `elem` cfgTrustedServices (storeConfig store)
      unless trusted $ error "Untrusted service"
      now <- getCurrentTime
      -- Bind user to session and store service token
      let updatedSess = sess
            { sessUser = Just uid
            , sessLastAuth = Just now
            , sessServiceTokens = Map.insert serviceName token (sessServiceTokens sess)
            }
      -- Session continuity: preserve session ID for service token binding
      -- The service token is bound to this specific session ID
      modifyIORef' (storeSessions store) (Map.insert sid updatedSess)
      return $ Right sid

-- Elevation request (e.g., before sensitive operation)
requestElevation :: SessionStore -> SessionId -> UserId -> IO (Either Text SessionId)
requestElevation store sid uid = do
  sessions <- readIORef (storeSessions store)
  case Map.lookup sid sessions of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Invalid session"
    Just sess -> do
      case sessUser sess of
        Nothing -> return $ Left "Not authenticated"
        Just currentUser ->
          if currentUser /= uid
            then return $ Left "User mismatch"
            else do
              now <- getCurrentTime
              let shouldRegenerate = cfgRegenerateOnElevation (storeConfig store)
              if shouldRegenerate
                then do
                  -- Regenerate session but preserve service token bindings
                  -- by keeping the OLD session active for token lookups
                  newSid <- generateSessionId
                  let elevatedSess = sess
                        { sessElevated = True
                        , sessLastAuth = Just now
                        }
                  modifyIORef' (storeSessions store) $ \m ->
                    Map.insert newSid elevatedSess m
                  -- Note: old session NOT deleted to maintain service token references
                  return $ Right newSid
                else do
                  let elevatedSess = sess { sessElevated = True, sessLastAuth = Just now }
                  modifyIORef' (storeSessions store) (Map.insert sid elevatedSess)
                  return $ Right sid

-- Validate session for protected resource access
validateSession :: SessionStore -> SessionId -> IO (Either Text (UserId, Bool))
validateSession store sid = do
  sessions <- readIORef (storeSessions store)
  case Map.lookup sid sessions of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Invalid session"
    Just sess -> case sessUser sess of
      Nothing -> return $ Left "Not authenticated"
      Just uid -> return $ Right (uid, sessElevated sess)

-- Logout: invalidate session
logoutSession :: SessionStore -> SessionId -> IO ()
logoutSession store sid =
  modifyIORef' (storeSessions store) (Map.delete sid)
